name: House Tang Guardian Cavalry to Tang Champion Progression

records.label: House Guardian Cavalry to Tang Champion

required_qualifications: discipline and House Tang loyalty review
facts.transaction: transfer one conserved body from House Guardian Cavalry to the House Tang Tang Champion reserve and create that person's persistent latent Champion identity exactly once

records.label: Tang Champion persistent identity boundary
notes: House Guards, Guardian Cavalry, Sword Manor ranks, and ordinary world forces remain aggregate cohorts unless separately materialized for evidence-backed narrative or command reasons.

Tang Champion promotion is an explicit fidelity boundary: every promoted Champion receives a stable persistent latent identity. Assignment to Tang Wei or another commander moves that same identity; it never creates a duplicate person.
Tang Wei personally recruited retinue personnel also use persistent latent identity from intake. This exception is player-personal and does not make all armies individual simulations.
